title: Erdős #993：树的 independent-set sequence 是否总是单峰？
solution_percent_basis: The universal conjecture remains open; the completed result is one strict new finite layer, from the previously certified frontier 30 to 31, with no reduction for larger orders.
confidence_percent_basis: The finite theorem has a complete exact census, two independent aggregators, serialized reconstruction, four materialized fail-closed rejection controls, isolated source rebuild, small-order subset cross-check, 24/24 Gate-4 audit, post-result novelty search, citation audit, clean LaTeX/PDF audit, and fresh-root ZIP reconstruction. The remaining one percent reflects the bounded nature of literature non-discovery and ordinary residual implementation risk, not a known certificate gap.
summary: NEW_STRICT_BOUND: all 120 fixed-modulus residues total exactly 40,330,829,030 unlabelled trees of order 31, matching A000055(31), with trees=generated and nonunimodal=0. Exactly 159 non-log-concave trees were serialized, independently rebuilt with Python integers, and confirmed unimodal. Production and no-project-import aggregators agree on sequence hash 92f46f1b00c219ad and parent hash d53b120ed8c90b52. Four fresh corruptions were each rejected with nonzero exit. Isolation rebuild, post-result novelty, formal-journal citation, LaTeX, PDF, manifest, and fresh-root release audits all passed. The proved theorem is only for n=31; the unrestricted conjecture remains open.
